'''Sister of the Voritor''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] rank and specialization.

==Overview==
These [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]] were tasked to guard the borders of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] lands on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They kept [[voritor lizard]] as pets and helpers, whence their name.
